reason: Five physical coast controls span Grindstone Island, northern Cumberland Basin shore and the Nova Scotia coast; source uncertainties are reported, not used as fit weights.
corrections: Grindstone and Cape Maringouin reference type corrected from Ocean to Tidal Watercourse before scoring; initial administrative-edge proposal rejected.
Peck Point source moved toward the actual shore bend before fitting.
not_adopted: St Mary Point and other highly generalized dashed New Brunswick contours not forced into additional observations.
Modern northern Grindstone projection not adopted because correspondence with historical natural shoreline is uncertain.
Administrative waterbody closing edges are not physical shores and are never observations.
limitations: Three New Brunswick checks, including one paired Grindstone check, and only one Nova Scotia check on the same head as a control.
New Brunswick dashed coast is coarsely generalized: working source uncertainty30 px versus18 px for Nova Scotia solid shore.
Northern river mouths, interior, southern offshore area and most Nova Scotia coast remain independently unvalidated.
